title: WaterColor Rental Home | Serendipity | Book WaterColor Rentals – Dune Vacation Rentals
meta_description: Serendipity is a large 2700 sq ft home featuring quick access to both Hwy 30A and 395. Book this WaterColor rental home for your next visit to WaterColor, FL!
description_expanded:
Serendipity is a wonderfully styled 2700 sq foot, three bedroom home tucked away just off Highway 395 and Highway 30A. Serendipity has stunning Australian Cyprus hardwood floors flowing throughout the living areas and bedrooms, and plenty of outdoor space. With cathedral ceilings, a fireplace in the living room, and a wooded backyard area, Serendipity is the perfect 30A vacation rental for those looking for their own little slice of heaven.

Guests will be greeted by a large living room with a high, beamed ceiling that creates an airy atmosphere. The living room has seating for seven and features a large flat screen TV. Tucked off the corner of the living area is a small office area for those looking to get a little work done during their visit. Connecting the living room to the kitchen is a wet bar, complete with a wine cooler and a copper sink. There is also a half bath on the first floor. The kitchen is fully equipped with stainless steel appliances, Viking stove top and microwave, and a warming drawer. Granite countertops, a SubZero fridge/freezer, an ice maker, and a Bosch dishwasher, round out the top of the line amenities in this spacious kitchen. The laundry room located just off the kitchen has stacked Maytag appliances. A large screened in private porch with dining space for six, additional seating space for five, and splendid views of a small pond, make for a private oasis in the backyard. There is also a small private patio area located just off the porch. The master suite is also conveniently located on the first floor. The master has a king bed, his and her closets, a flat-screen TV, and a beautiful master bath. The master bath has a steam shower with a ceiling mount shower head, dual vanities, and a separate claw-foot tub.

On the second floor, you will find a lofty den with a set of twin bunks, a large flat screen TV, and a sofa. The twin guest bedroom has two twin beds, a TV and walk-in closet and adjoins to the den by a full bath. There is also a queen suite on the second floor complete with a flat-screen TV and a private bathroom with a shower. As an added bonus there is surround sound systems throughout the house.

Serendipity is just minutes from the beach, restaurants, and Publix, Serendipity is slightly secluded, yet practical. Every bedroom has a flat-screen TV and a bathroom for convenience. Located in a family-friendly community, with plenty of outdoor space, this home is perfect for families with children.

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights

3 Bedrooms

3 1/2 Baths

2700 Square Feet

Fabulous Outdoor Space

Surround Sound

Propane Grill

3 Beach Cruiser Bicycles

Complimentary Trolley Rides via WaterColor Trolley App

8 Amenity Wristbands

Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club

First Floor

- Private office off living room

- Wet bar with wine cooler and copper sink

- Kitchen with stainless steel appliances featuring a Viking stovetop and microwave, SubZero refrigerator and freezer, Bosch dishwasher

- Master bedroom with private bathroom with dual vanities, steam shower, and clawfoot tub

- Screened-in porch with dining space for 6 guests and additional seating for 5 guests

- Laundry room

- Half bathroom

Second Floor

- Lofty den with set of twin bunks

- Guest bedroom with two twin beds with access to the full bathroom

- Guest bedroom with queen bed and private bathroom with a shower

Additional

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 2 Vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- Golf cart rentals are not recommended at this property due to lack of exterior charging capabilities.

- 8 Amenity Wristbands - Maximum. Extras are not available. Access to All WaterColor Community Swimming Pools - Camp WaterColor and the Beach Club.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 Cancellation Fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancellations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM.

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
